title: KANAKU — Audit Trail
description: Financial audit trail sourced from Pino structured logs via Grafana Cloud Loki. Logs are pushed via the Render log-drain webhook → /internal/logs/drain → Loki. The app=kanaku label is set by the log-drain handler.

panels.title: Audit events over time (by action)
panels.description: Count of [AUDIT] log lines per event type. Spikes indicate unusual financial activity.

panels.title: Failure events (range)
panels.description: Count of [AUDIT] entries with status=failure — failed financial operations. Any non-zero value needs investigation.

panels.title: Top actions
panels.description: Most frequent audit event types in the time range.

panels.title: Top actors (userId)
panels.description: Users with the most financial mutations. Unusual high counts may indicate abuse.

panels.title: Audit records — search by actor / request ID (filters above)
panels.description: Full audit log stream. Filter by userId or requestId using the variables at the top. Each line is a redacted Pino JSON log with [AUDIT] prefix.

panels.title: All errors (level=error) — last 24h
panels.description: All logger.error() calls from the API and worker. Each has requestId for correlation with the user report.
